thesis: The speaker argues that owning even a tiny amount of land acts as a critical asset that grants access to credit markets, allowing individuals to weather economic shocks and preventing them from falling deeper into poverty. He further contends that academic research is often backward-looking and isolatory, leading him to leave academia for a career in asset management where he can apply a structured, forward-looking approach to make immediate impact.
